## Summary

**Task completed: Extract canvas drawing helpers from GameBoard.tsx**

### What was done
- Created `app/components/canvas-drawing.ts` — a new module containing all 11 canvas drawing functions that were previously embedded inline in GameBoard.tsx
- Updated `GameBoard.tsx` to import from the new module, removing ~380 lines of inline helper functions
- Cleaned up unused imports in GameBoard.tsx (removed `Direction`, `PlacedTile`, `TileType`, `Rotation` types and `NORTH`, `EAST`, `SOUTH`
